# The Independent Designer’s Research Department — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-157996
Voiceover: A less-remembered house remains researchable because its object record survives.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art; Gift of Marion Litchfield, 1950

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — B07-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · ASK — Can the question change the work?. Frame a bounded design or institutional question, a decision date, relevant communities, and evidence that would require revision. “Inspiration” is too broad to audit.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B07-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · SOURCE — Can each reference be recovered?. Preserve creator, title, date, institution, identifier, canonical URL, access date, rights statement, excerpt limits, and local notes. Keep link-only records visible without copying restricted media.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B07-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · INTERPRET — Where does fact end and judgment begin?. Write source description, studio inference, transformation, disagreement, and cultural-authority question in separate fields. This prevents an appealing object from being made to prove more than its record supports.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B07-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · RETURN — What did research change?. Attach the altered silhouette, material, process, refusal, claim, credit, or archive rule to the source trail. If nothing changed, record why the reference was rejected rather than laundering it into a mood board.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
